\begin{document}
All quantities below are matrices in orbital space and do not commute.
Resumming the Dyson series gives
\begin{equation}
G(\omega) = G_0(\omega)\left[1 - \Sigma(\omega)\,G_0(\omega)\right]^{-1} ,
\label{eq:d1}
\end{equation}
which we also write as
\begin{equation}
G(\omega) = \left[1 - \Sigma(\omega)\,G_0(\omega)\right]^{-1} G_0(\omega) .
\label{eq:d2}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
